---
title: "SRA cohort demographics (Fig. 1A-D)"
output: html_notebook
---

Ported from the original Fig1-panels notebook. Panels 1A and 1B were made from one
alluvial chunk by toggling commented-out lines; here each is its own chunk.

```{r setup}
source(here::here("R", "paths.R"))
source(here::here("R", "metadata.R"))
library(tidyverse)
library(ggalluvial)

FIGURES_DIR <- out_path("figures")
dir.create(FIGURES_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

newDataset <- read_metadata()

# One row per patient, with study, demographics and (latest) tissue
patients <- newDataset %>%
  group_by(BioProject, Age, Sex, Disease, DonorID, `Disease Class`) %>%
  summarize(count = n(), Tissue = max(Tissue), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Disease = fct_lump_n(Disease, n = 1, other_level = 'Study controls')) %>%
  mutate(Tissue = fct_lump_n(Tissue, n = 3)) %>%
  mutate(Sex = fct_explicit_na(Sex, na_level = "Missing")) %>%
  mutate(Sex = fct_collapse(Sex, Missing = c("Missing", "UKN"))) %>%   # unknown sex shown as Missing, as in the paper
  mutate(
    Age = cut(
          Age,
          breaks = seq(0, 100, by = 15),
          include.lowest = T,
          right = F,
          labels = c("0-15", "15-30", "30-45", "45-60", "60-75", "75-90"),
          ordered_result = T),
    Age = fct_rev(Age),
    Age = fct_explicit_na(Age, na_level = "Missing"),
    Age = fct_relevel(Age, "Missing", after = Inf)
  )

alluvial_plot <- function(df, second_axis) {
  df %>%
    group_by({{ second_axis }}, Tissue, Disease) %>%
    summarise(Count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    ggplot(aes(y = Count, axis1 = Disease, axis2 = {{ second_axis }})) +
    geom_alluvium(width = 1/6, aes(fill = Tissue)) +
    geom_stratum(width = 1/6, fill = "black", color = "grey") +
    geom_label(stat = "stratum", aes(label = after_stat(stratum))) +
    scale_x_discrete(limits = c("Tissue", "Sex"), expand = c(0,0)) +
    theme_light() +
    theme(aspect.ratio = 2,
          panel.grid = element_blank(),
          axis.text.x = element_blank()) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0,0)) +
    scale_fill_viridis_d(option = 'turbo')
}
```

```{r Fig 1A: disease by sex and tissue}
alluvial_plot(patients, Sex)
ggsave(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "fig1A_demographics_disease_sex.svg"))
```

```{r Fig 1B: disease by age and tissue}
alluvial_plot(patients, Age)
ggsave(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "fig1B_demographics_disease_age.svg"))
```

```{r Fig 1C: patient age distribution}
newDataset %>%
  group_by(BioProject, Age, Sex, Disease, DonorID, `Disease Class`) %>%
  summarize(count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Disease = fct_lump_n(Disease, n = 1, other_level = 'Study controls')) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Age, fill = Disease)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5, adjust = 2) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = 'rocket') +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0,0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0,0))

ggsave(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "fig1C_age_density.svg"))
```

```{r Fig 1D: publication year by study}
newDataset %>%
  group_by(BioProject) %>%
  summarise(`Publication Year` = max(year(ReleaseDate))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = `Publication Year`)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 1) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 24) +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 0.5) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0,0)) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0,0), breaks = c(2014,2016,2018,2020,2022,2024)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 2022, color = 'red', size = 2) +
  labs(y = 'Studies')

ggsave(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "fig1D_publication_year_studies.svg"))
```

```{r Fig 1D: publication year by patient}
newDataset %>%
  group_by(BioProject, Age, Sex, Disease, DonorID, `Disease Class`) %>%
  summarise(`Publication Year` = max(year(ReleaseDate)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = `Publication Year`)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 1) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 24) +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 0.5) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0,0)) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0,0), breaks = c(2014,2016,2018,2020,2022,2024)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 2022, color = 'red', size = 2) +
  labs(y = 'Patients')

ggsave(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "fig1D_publication_year_patients.svg"))
```
